item.title: From Active Clubs to ‘Acceleration Clubs’: How Neo-Nazi Accelerationists Are Adapting the Active Club Model
item.dc:creator: Muskan Sangwan
item.description: Active Clubs have become an established organisational model within transnational white-supremacist movements, combining physical fitness, combat sports and local activism with a decentralised network of like-minded groups. Local chapters retain some operational autonomy rather than answering to a single central command, while shared messaging, online promotion, and cross-group relationships connect them to a wider ideological milieu.
